description: We are the Westbridge Robotics Team of Liceo Campestre Nuevo Pacto, a group passionate about technology, robotics, and space exploration. Our mission is to identify places on Earth that resemble the environments where permanent bases could be built on the Moon and Mars. Through science, creativity, and teamwork, we seek innovative solutions to understand the challenges of living beyond our planet. We dream of exploring new worlds and building the future of humanity among the stars.
